thread:
morgan: Quick sync — microchart compact mode UX. Noticing confusing ticks when values hover near zero, and VoiceOver reads 'zero' for tiny positives. Thoughts?

jia: Can you attach examples? screenshot?

morgan: pasted a small gif in thread but here's data snippet:
```
[0.01, 0.02, 0.003, 0.0, 0.0001]
```

roland: VoiceOver reads actual numbers — maybe we should clamp to two sig figs and add aria-label: 'Trend: small variance around zero'.

matt: Clamping is OK but might hide spikes. Proposal: add a 'unit hint' toggle for microcharts showing absolute units on hover. Hover = brief tooltip.

jia: For keyboard/VO: tooltip won't help. Need accessible summary always present in DOM but visually hidden. aria-live update on focus?

morgan: Good call. What about outlier dots — currently they obscure line in very compact layout. Would love a policy: render outliers as hollow dots + 1px border and a11y text 'outlier at X'.

roland: +1 to hollow dots. Also consider smoothing off by default for microcharts; they make small spikes look worse. Maybe smoothing presets: 'none' | 'light' | 'trend'.

matt: Smoothing presets seem nice. How do we expose in Console? small dropdown on chart controls? Or global setting per dashboard?

jia: Prefer per-widget — different charts need different behavior.

morgan: Copy tweak: change tooltip from 'value' to 'value (approx)' when smoothing on. Also add microcopy for 'compact mode: shows relative trend, not precise values'.

roland: Accessibility nit: VoiceOver reads 'approx' weirdly. Use 'approximately' instead.

matt: Dev note: CSS trick for invisible but focusable summary:
```
.sr-summary { position: absolute; left: -9999px; top: auto; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; }
```

jia: Can we instead use aria-hidden on viz elements and expose aria-label on wrapper? keeps SR tree simple.

morgan: Action items:
- design: mockup of compact controls (jia)
- engineering: implement sr-summary pattern or aria-label approach and test with VO (matt)
- docs: write copy for smoothed/compact warnings (roland)

morgan: ETA for mocks end of week? :calendar:

jia: yes, will post mock by Thu EOD :+1:

matt: I'll spike VO tests next sprint.

roland: I'll draft the copy today and add to the style guide.
